developmentBacklogAdded.name: Freelance client trust gate
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: High headline budgets from brand-new clients with generic task descriptions can consume connects/time while carrying elevated scam, cancellation or low-conversion risk.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Add a trust score combining account age, verified spend/hire history, specificity of scope, client activity and budget plausibility; require a minimum trust threshold before high-budget freelance listings receive priority alerts.

developmentBacklogAdded.name: Recurring-scope fixed-price anomaly detector
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: Listings can advertise a tiny fixed price while describing ongoing weekly/monthly ownership, making the displayed budget misleading.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Detect recurring language such as ongoing, monthly, weekly, manage/monitor and training, compare it with fixed-price budget, and automatically flag or suppress severe scope-to-budget anomalies before manual review.
